Identify each marginal square with its sibling masses and conclude the unchanged total squared norm target.

cases.independent_root_reference:
by
  intro N A i j distinct theta
  have sameI : ((A.updateRow j (A i)).updateRow i (A i)).det = 0 := by
    apply _root_.Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq distinct
    simp [distinct.symm]
  have sameJ : ((A.updateRow j (A j)).updateRow i (A j)).det = 0 := by
    apply _root_.Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq distinct
    simp [distinct.symm]
  have original : (A.updateRow j (A j)).updateRow i (A i) = A := by simp
  have swapEq : (A.updateRow j (A i)).updateRow i (A j) =
      A.submatrix (Equiv.swap i j) id := by
    ext row col
    by_cases hi : row = i <;> by_cases hj : row = j <;>
      simp_all [_root_.Matrix.updateRow_apply, _root_.Matrix.submatrix_apply,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have swapDet : ((A.updateRow j (A i)).updateRow i (A j)).det = -A.det := by
    rw [swapEq, _root_.Matrix.det_permute, Equiv.Perm.sign_swap distinct]
    simp
  have mix : ∀ (a b c d : ℝ),
      ((A.updateRow i (a • A i + b • A j)).updateRow j (c • A i + d • A j)).det =
        (a * d - b * c) * A.det := by
    intro a b c d
    simp only [_root_.Matrix.det_updateRow_add, _root_.Matrix.det_updateRow_smul]
    rw [_root_.Matrix.updateRow_comm A distinct, _root_.Matrix.updateRow_comm A distinct]
    simp only [_root_.Matrix.det_updateRow_add, _root_.Matrix.det_updateRow_smul,
      sameI, sameJ, original, swapDet]
    ring
  have eqRows : QuantumBlockEncoding.AdjacentGivens.rotateRows A i j theta =
      (A.updateRow i (Real.cos (theta / 2) • A i + (-Real.sin (theta / 2)) • A j)).updateRow j
        (Real.sin (theta / 2) • A i + Real.cos (theta / 2) • A j) := by
    ext row col
    by_cases hi : row = i <;> by_cases hj : row = j <;>
      simp_all [QuantumBlockEncoding.AdjacentGivens.rotateRows, _root_.Matrix.updateRow_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have unitFactor : Real.cos (theta / 2) * Real.cos (theta / 2) -
      (-Real.sin (theta / 2)) * Real.sin (theta / 2) = 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (theta / 2)]
  rw [eqRows, mix, unitFactor, one_mul]

interfaces.name: Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq
interfaces.type: ∀ {n : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {M : Matrix n n R} {i j : n}, i ≠ j → M i = M j → M.det = 0

interfaces.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_add
interfaces.type: ∀ {n : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (u v : n → R), (M.updateRow j (u + v)).det = (M.updateRow j u).det + (M.updateRow j v).det

interfaces.name: Matrix.det_updateRow_smul
interfaces.type: ∀ {n : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R) (j : n) (s : R) (u : n → R), (M.updateRow j (s • u)).det = s * (M.updateRow j u).det

interfaces.name: Matrix.updateRow_comm
interfaces.type: ∀ {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) {i i' : m}, i ≠ i' → ∀ (x y : n → α), (A.updateRow i x).updateRow i' y = (A.updateRow i' y).updateRow i x

interfaces.name: Matrix.det_permute
interfaces.type: ∀ {n : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (σ : Equiv.Perm n) (M : Matrix n n R), (M.submatrix (⇑σ) id).det = ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) * M.det

interfaces.name: Equiv.Perm.sign_swap
interfaces.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] {x y : α}, x ≠ y → Equiv.Perm.sign (Equiv.swap x y) = -1

interfaces.name: Matrix.updateRow_apply
interfaces.type: ∀ {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} {α : Type u_1} {M : Matrix m n α} {i : m} {j : n} {b : n → α} [DecidableEq m] {i' : m}, M.updateRow i b i' j = if i' = i then b j else M i' j

interfaces.name: Matrix.submatrix_apply
interfaces.type: ∀ {l : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} {n : Type u_4} {o : Type u_5} {α : Type u_1} (A : Matrix m n α) (r : l → m) (c : o → n) (i : l) (j : o), A.submatrix r c i j = A (r i) (c j)

interfaces.name: Equiv.swap_apply_def
interfaces.type: ∀ {α : Sort u_1} [DecidableEq α] (a b x : α), (Equiv.swap a b) x = if x = a then b else if x = b then a else x

knowledge_assumption_rubric.criterion: Show both repeated-original-row determinants vanish; i≠j is necessary.
Identify the remaining exchanged-row matrix with a single row transposition and keep its negative determinant sign.
Expand both updated rows into four terms; eliminate the repeated-row terms and collect (a*d-b*c)*det A.
Align rotateRows with simultaneous mixing of the original two rows, using cos(theta/2), -sin(theta/2), sin(theta/2), cos(theta/2).
The determinant factor is cos²+sin²=1; conclude preservation for arbitrary A without orthogonality, adjacency, order i<j or determinant-one input assumptions.
